propositions.statement: Let p be any prime, K any field of characteristic p, λ an integer with 0≤λ<p, V=V(λ) the complex irreducible highest-weight sl₂-module of dimension λ+1, and x,y,h its Chevalley operators satisfying hx−xh=2x, hy−yh=−2y, xy−yx=h. Let v∈V be nonzero with xv=0 and hv=λv. Let U_ℤ be the integer enveloping subalgebra generated by all X_r=x^r/r! and Y_r=y^r/r!, r≥0. Let M⊆V be any U_ℤ-stable free abelian subgroup with an integer basis also a complex basis of V. The target space is M⊗_ℤ K with the induced x,y,h actions and the Chevalley Lie algebra (ℤx+ℤy+ℤh)⊗_ℤ K, including characteristic two.

For every natural m, complex vector space V of dimension m+1, endomorphisms x,y,h with hx−xh=2x, hy−yh=−2y, xy−yx=h, and nonzero v with xv=0 and hv=mv, the vectors e_i=y^i v/i!, 0≤i≤m, form a complex basis. They satisfy xe_0=0, xe_i=(m−i+1)e_(i−1) for 1≤i≤m, ye_i=(i+1)e_(i+1) for i<m, ye_m=0 and he_i=(m−2i)e_i. For all r≥0, X_r=x^r/r! sends e_i to choose(m−i+r,r)e_(i−r) if r≤i and to zero otherwise; Y_r=y^r/r! sends e_i to choose(i+r,r)e_(i+r) if i+r≤m and to zero otherwise.

For every natural m, complex vector space V with basis e_0,…,e_m and divided powers X_r=x^r/r!,Y_r=y^r/r! having the action formulas in the following explicit form: X_r e_i=choose(m−i+r,r)e_(i−r) for r≤i and zero otherwise, Y_r e_i=choose(i+r,r)e_(i+r) for i+r≤m and zero otherwise, let M⊆V be any integer submodule preserved by all X_r,Y_r. Put D=m!, q_j=j!(m−j)!, T_ij=X_(m−i)Y_m X_m Y_(m−j) and s_ij=(q_j T_ij)|M. Then s_ij∈End_ℤ M, s_ij s_kl=δ_jk D s_il, and Σ_(i=0)^m s_ii=D Id_M. For every r≥0 the restrictions satisfy r!(X_r|M)=(x|M)^r and r!(Y_r|M)=(y|M)^r. Here x=X_1,y=Y_1, multiplication is composition with right factor first, and δ_jk is 1 if j=k and 0 otherwise.

For every natural m, abelian group M with an integer basis b_0,…,b_m, and field K, the space K⊗_ℤ M has basis 1⊗b_0,…,1⊗b_m and dimension m+1, and is nonzero. The tensor flip m⊗a↦a⊗m identifies M⊗_ℤ K, equipped with its K-action on the second factor, K-linearly with K⊗_ℤ M. For every integer endomorphism f of M this flip intertwines f⊗Id_K with Id_K⊗f.

For every prime p, field K of characteristic p, natural m<p, integer module M, endomorphisms x,y∈End_ℤ M and sequences A_r,B_r∈End_ℤ M with A_1=x, B_1=y, r!A_r=x^r and r!B_r=y^r, suppose the endomorphisms s_ij=j!(m−j)! A_(m−i) B_m A_m B_(m−j), indexed by 0≤i,j≤m, satisfy s_ij s_kl=δ_jk m! s_il and Σ_i s_ii=m! Id_M. On K⊗_ℤ M let Φ(f)(a⊗u)=a⊗f(u), d=(m!:K), and U_ij=d⁻¹Φ(s_ij). Then d≠0, U_ij U_kl=δ_jk U_il and Σ_i U_ii=Id. Every K-subspace preserved by Φ(x) and Φ(y) is preserved by all U_ij. The conclusion applies when m=0, and requires no algebraic closure or reduced-weight distinctness.

For every field K, positive natural N, finite-dimensional K-vector space Q with dim_K Q=N, and endomorphisms U_ij indexed by Fin N satisfying U_ij U_kl=δ_jk U_il and Σ_i U_ii=Id_Q, every K-linear subspace W⊆Q preserved by all U_ij is zero or all Q. Multiplication is composition with the right factor acting first.

Let \(p\) be any prime, \(K\) any field of characteristic \(p\), and
\(\lambda\) an integer with \(0\leq\lambda<p\).
Let \(V(\lambda)\) be the complex irreducible highest-weight
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\)-module of highest weight \(\lambda\),
of dimension \(\lambda+1\). Its Chevalley generators satisfy

\[
[h,x]=2x,\qquad[h,y]=-2y,\qquad[x,y]=h.
\]

Choose a nonzero highest-weight vector \(v\) with \(xv=0\) and
\(hv=\lambda v\). Let \(U_{\mathbb Z}\) be the integer subalgebra of
the universal enveloping algebra generated by all divided powers
\(X_r=x^r/r!\), \(Y_r=y^r/r!\), for integers \(r\geq0\).
An **admissible lattice** \(M\subset V(\lambda)\) is a free abelian
subgroup with an integer basis that is also a complex basis, stable under
\(U_{\mathbb Z}\). It is arbitrary, not necessarily the minimal lattice.

Put \(V(K)=M\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\). The Lie algebra
\(L(K)=(\mathbb Zx+\mathbb Zy+\mathbb Zh)\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\)
acts by the induced lattice operators. This is the Chevalley
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) construction also in characteristic 2.
Prove that \(V(K)\) is nonzero and every \(K\)-linear subspace
invariant under \(x,y,h\) is zero or all of \(V(K)\).
Both \(\lambda=0\) and \(p=2\) are included; \(K\) need not be
algebraically closed.

For every complex vector space V, every index type I, endomorphism f, injective eigenvalue family μ:I→ℂ, and family a:I→V of nonzero f-eigenvectors with f(a_i)=μ_i a_i, the family a is complex-linearly independent.
For every field K, finite-dimensional K-vector space V, natural n, and independent family a:Fin n→V with dim_K V=n, the K-linear span of the range of a is all V.
For every abelian group M with its integer module structure, every integer basis b indexed by Fin n, and every field K, there exists a K-basis c of K⊗_ℤ M indexed by Fin n whose ith vector is 1⊗b_i.
For every abelian group M with its integer module structure and every field K, there exists a unital ℤ-algebra homomorphism Φ:End_ℤ(M)→End_K(K⊗_ℤ M) with Φ(f)(a⊗m)=a⊗f(m) for every f,a,m.
For every prime p, field K of characteristic p, and natural r<p, the image of r! in K is a unit.
For every field K, K-vector space V, natural n and basis b:Fin n→V, the dimension finrank_K V equals n.
